jobs.title: Group Manager Global Events 100% (m/w)
jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung an unserem Hauptsitz in Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Group Manager Global Events für unsere Abteilung Marketing and Medical Education. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die strategische und operative Gesamtverantwortung für die globale Eventorganisation von Medartis und führen ein internationales Event-Team mit sechs Mitarbeitenden. Sie entwickeln die globale Eventstrategie weiter, steuern ein vielfältiges internationales Veranstaltungsportfolio und gestalten die digitale und organisatorische Weiterentwicklung der Eventfunktion aktiv mit. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit Marketing, Sales, Product Management, IBRA und der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur internationalen Markenpräsenz sowie zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung der Medartis Gruppe.

Möchten Sie als strategischer Sparringspartner für die globale Eventorganisation wirken, ein internationales Team weiterentwickeln und die weltweite Präsenz von Medartis auf Kongressen, Fachmessen und weiteren Veranstaltungen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt als

Group Manager Global Events 100% (m/w)

Ihr Aufgabengebiet

• Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung eines globalen Event-Teams mit sechs Mitarbeitenden.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung der globalen Eventstrategie sowie Gesamtverantwortung für die strategische Planung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des internationalen Veranstaltungsportfolios, einschliesslich Kongressen, Fachmessen, Symposien, Produkteinführungen und IBRA Events.

• Strategische Weiterentwicklung der globalen Kongress- und Messepräsenz als Bestandteil der Customer Journey, zur Leadgenerierung und zur Stärkung der internationalen Markenpräsenz von Medartis.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Sales, Product Management, IBRA und der Geschäftsleitung sowie Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu externen Partnern, Veranstaltern und Industriepartnern.

• Verantwortung für die digitale Transformation und kontinuierliche Optimierung der globalen Eventorganisation, einschliesslich Logistik, Prozessen, Cross-Charging sowie der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Tools und Systeme.

• Weiterentwicklung hybrider und digitaler Veranstaltungsformate sowie Integration von Event-Apps, Lead-Capturing-Technologien und CRM-Systemen.

• Gesamtverantwortung für das globale Eventbudget, die effiziente Ressourcenallokation sowie die Definition und Analyse relevanter KPIs zur Erfolgsmessung und kontinuierlichen Optimierung des Eventprogramms.

• Sicherstellung eines weltweit konsistenten und markenkonformen Auftritts von Medartis bei sämtlichen Veranstaltungen.

Ihre Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Eventmanagement, Marketing, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im internationalen Event- oder Kongressmanagement, idealerweise in einem global tätigen Unternehmen.

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden und ausgeprägte Leadership-Kompetenzen.

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung globaler Eventstrategien sowie in der Steuerung komplexer internationaler Veranstaltungsprojekte.

• Ausgeprägte strategische und unternehmerische Denkweise sowie Erfahrung im Budgetmanagement, Stakeholder-Management und in der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams.

• Erfahrung im Change-Management sowie in der Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen und Arbeitsweisen.

• Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, Eventmanagement-Software sowie digitalen Event- und Lead-Management-Lösungen; analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im KPI-basierten Reporting.

• Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und sicheres Auftreten sowie ein kooperativer und wertschätzender Führungsstil.

• Sehr gute Organisationsfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Belastbarkeit, Kommuninikation und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Französischkenntnisse und weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Reisebereitschaft ca. 30%

Medartis ist einer der führenden Hersteller von medizinischen Produkten für die Osteosynthese im Bereich des Gesichtsschädels und der Extremitäten. Medartis hat sich zum Wohle des Patienten verpflichtet, Chirurgen und OP-Personal mit den innovativsten Titanimplantaten und Instrumenten zu versorgen und den besten Service zu bieten.

Per rafforzare la nostra sede a Basilea, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata come Group Manager Global Events per il nostro reparto Marketing e Medical Education. In questo ruolo, si assume la responsabilità strategica e operativa complessiva per l’organizzazione globale degli eventi di Medartis e guida un team internazionale di eventi con sei dipendenti. Sviluppino ulteriormente la strategia globale degli eventi, controllano un portafoglio eventi internazionale diversificato e modellano attivamente lo sviluppo digitale e organizzativo della funzione evento. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il marketing, le vendite, la gestione dei prodotti, IBRA e la gestione e dare un importante contributo alla presenza internazionale del marchio e allo sviluppo strategico del Gruppo Medartis.

Desiderate agire come partner strategico per l’organizzazione globale degli eventi, sviluppare un team internazionale e plasmare attivamente la presenza globale di Medartis a convegni, fiere e altri eventi? Quindi applicare ora come

Gruppo Gestione Globale Eventi 100% (m/f)

Le tue responsabilità

• Gestione professionale e disciplinare così come ulteriore sviluppo di un team di eventi globale con sei dipendenti.

• Sviluppo e implementazione della strategia globale degli eventi, nonché della responsabilità generale per la pianificazione strategica, la gestione e l'ulteriore sviluppo del portafoglio eventi internazionali, tra cui congressi, fiere, simposi, lancio di prodotti e eventi IBRA.

• Sviluppo strategico del congresso globale e della presenza fieristica nell’ambito del percorso clienti, per generare piombo e rafforzare la presenza internazionale del marchio Medartis.

• Garantire una presenza globale coerente e conforme al marchio di Medartis in tutti gli eventi.

Le tue qualifiche

• Studi completati in gestione degli eventi, marketing, amministrazione aziendale o una disciplina comparabile, nonché diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione di eventi internazionali o congressi, idealmente in una società globale.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza nella gestione professionale e disciplinare, nonché ulteriore sviluppo dei dipendenti e forti capacità di leadership.

• Dimostrare l'esperienza nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di eventi globali e nella gestione di complessi progetti di eventi internazionali.

• Forte pensiero strategico e imprenditoriale, nonché esperienza nella gestione del bilancio, nella gestione degli stakeholder e in collaborazione con team interdisciplinari e internazionali.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei cambiamenti e nella digitalizzazione e ottimizzazione dei processi e dei metodi di lavoro.

• Esperienza con sistemi CRM, software di gestione degli eventi e soluzioni di gestione dei lead; Competenze analitiche ed esperienza nel reporting basato su KPI.

• Forza di comunicazione, capacità di negoziazione e aspetto fiducioso, nonché uno stile di leadership cooperativo e apprezzativo.

• Ottima capacità organizzativa, iniziativa, senso di responsabilità, resilienza, comunicazione e assertività.

• Conoscenza negoziabile del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura. La conoscenza del francese e delle altre lingue sono utili.

To strengthen our headquarters in Basel, we are looking for a committed personality as Group Manager Global Events for our Marketing and Medical Education department. In this role, you assume overall strategic and operational responsibility for Medartis’ global event organisation and lead an international event team with six employees. They further develop the global event strategy, control a diverse international event portfolio and actively shape the digital and organizational further development of the event function. You will work closely with marketing, sales, product management, IBRA and the management and make an important contribution to the international brand presence and the strategic development of the Medartis Group.

Would you like to act as a strategic sparring partner for the global event organisation, develop an international team and actively shape Medartis’ global presence at congresses, trade fairs and other events? Then apply now as

Group Manager Global Events 100% (m/f)

Your responsibilities

• Professional and disciplinary management as well as further development of a global event team with six employees.

• Development and implementation of the global event strategy as well as overall responsibility for the strategic planning, management and further development of the international event portfolio, including congresses, trade fairs, symposia, product launches and IBRA events.

• Strategic development of the global congress and trade fair presence as part of the customer journey, to generate lead and to strengthen Medartis’ international brand presence.

• Close cooperation with marketing, sales, product management, IBRA and the management as well as building and maintaining sustainable relationships with external partners, event organisers and industry partners.

• Responsibility for the digital transformation and continuous optimization of the global event organization, including logistics, processes, cross-charging and the introduction and further development of digital tools and systems.

• Further development of hybrid and digital event formats as well as integration of event apps, lead capturing technologies and CRM systems.

• Overall responsibility for the global event budget, efficient resource allocation and the definition and analysis of relevant KPIs for success measurement and continuous optimization of the event program.

• Ensuring a globally consistent and brand-compliant presence of Medartis at all events.

Your qualifications

• Completed studies in event management, marketing, business administration or a comparable discipline as well as several years of professional experience in international event or congress management, ideally in a global company.

• At least five years of experience in professional and disciplinary management as well as further development of employees and strong leadership skills.

• Demonstrate experience in the development and implementation of global event strategies as well as in the management of complex international event projects.

• Strong strategic and entrepreneurial thinking as well as experience in budget management, stakeholder management and in cooperation with interdisciplinary and international teams.

• Experience in change management as well as in the digitalization and optimization of processes and working methods.

• Experience with CRM systems, event management software and digital event and lead management solutions; Analytical skills and experience in KPI-based reporting.

• Communication strength, negotiation skills and confident appearance as well as a cooperative and appreciative leadership style.

• Very good organizational ability, initiative, sense of responsibility, resilience, communication and assertiveness.

• Negotiable knowledge of German and English in word and writing. Knowledge of French and other languages are beneficial.

• Willingness to travel about 30%

About Medartis

Medartis is one of the leading manufacturers of medical products for osteosynthesis in the area of the facial skull and extremities. For the benefit of the patient, Medartis is committed to providing surgeons and surgical staff with the most innovative titanium implants and instruments and providing the best service.

We offer you a responsible and varied activity with high quality requirements in a growing, international company with progressive social benefits.

We look forward to your complete online application.

In dieser Rolle tragen Sie wesentlich dazu bei, dass unsere Produkt- und Marketingdokumentation den höchsten Qualitäts- und Compliance-Anforderungen entspricht. Sie begleiten Dokumente über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus, stellen deren Aktualität und Verfügbarkeit sicher und arbeiten eng mit Marketing, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs sowie weiteren interdisziplinären Teams zusammen. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie die kontinuierliche Digitalisierung und Optimierung unserer Dokumentationsprozesse.
Möchten Sie mit Ihrer strukturierten Arbeitsweise und Ihrem Qualitätsbewusstsein einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg innovativer Medizintechnik leisten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Associate Documentation Manager

Ihr Aufgabengebiet

• Sie unterstützen die Verwaltung der globalen Produkt- und Marketingdokumentation über den gesamten Dokumentenlebenszyklus.

• Sie pflegen Dokumentenmanagementsysteme, Datenbanken und Dokumentenablagen und stellen die Vollständigkeit, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Aktualität der Dokumentation sicher.

• Sie prüfen und überarbeiten Dokumente hinsichtlich Verständlichkeit, Konsistenz, Sprache, Layout sowie der Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen und Corporate-Design-Richtlinien.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit Marketing, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs und weiteren internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine qualitativ hochwertige und termingerechte Dokumentation sicherzustellen.

• Sie unterstützen die Erstellung und Pflege von Bestellinformationen, Produktkatalogen sowie die Kommunikation dokumentationsrelevanter Änderungen.

• Sie koordinieren die Verwaltung gedruckter Dokumentationen, einschliesslich Druckaufträgen und Lagerbeständen.

• Sie wirken aktiv an der Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Dokumentationsprozessen, Systemen und Arbeitsabläufen mit.

• Sie leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Einhaltung interner Qualitätsstandards sowie regulatorischer Anforderungen und stellen eine effiziente Dokumentationsverwaltung sicher.

Ihre Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung mit einer Weiterbildung in Marketing, Kommunikation, technischer Dokumentation oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Zwei bis fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Medizintechnik, Pharmaindustrie oder einem vergleichbaren regulierten Umfeld.

• Erfahrung im Bereich technischer Dokumentation, Dokumentenmanagement oder regulatorischer Dokumentationsprozesse.

• Ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie eine strukturierte, präzise und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Dokumentenmanagementsystemen sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office 365; Kenntnisse in Adobe Acrobat/InDesign sowie TYPO3 oder PLM-Systemen sind von Vorteil.

• Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und gut organisierte Arbeitsweise.

• Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Über Medartis

Medartis ist einer der führenden Hersteller von medizinischen Produkten für die Osteosynthese im Bereich des Gesichtsschädels und der Extremitäten. Medartis hat sich zum Wohle des Patienten verpflichtet, Chirurgen und OP-Personal mit den innovativsten Titanimplantaten und Instrumenten zu versorgen und den besten Service zu bieten.

Wir bieten Ihnen eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hohen Qualitätsanforderungen in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen mit fortschrittlichen Sozialleistungen.

• Essi sostengono la creazione e la manutenzione di informazioni sugli ordini, cataloghi di prodotti e la comunicazione di modifiche rilevanti per la documentazione.

• Partecipate attivamente alla digitalizzazione e alla continua ottimizzazione dei processi di documentazione, dei sistemi e dei flussi di lavoro.

• Essi forniscono un importante contributo al rispetto degli standard di qualità interni e dei requisiti normativi e garantiscono una gestione efficiente della documentazione.

Le tue qualifiche

• Formazione tecnica o commerciale completata con ulteriore formazione in marketing, comunicazione, documentazione tecnica o una specializzazione comparabile.

• Due o cinque anni di esperienza professionale in tecnologia medica, industria farmaceutica o un ambiente regolamentato comparabile.

• Esperienza nei processi di documentazione tecnica, gestione dei documenti o documentazione regolamentare.

• Forte consapevolezza della qualità e un modo di lavoro strutturato, preciso e affidabile.

• L'esperienza di lavoro con i sistemi di gestione dei documenti e la conoscenza molto buona di Microsoft Office 365; La conoscenza di Adobe Acrobat/InDesign e dei sistemi TYPO3 o PLM è un vantaggio.

• Capacità di pensiero analitico e un modo di lavoro indipendente, orientato alla soluzione e ben organizzato.

• Personalità orientata al team con forti capacità di comunicazione e godere di lavorare insieme in un ambiente internazionale.

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese nelle parole e nella scrittura; Ulteriori competenze linguistiche sono vantaggiose.

Medartis è uno dei principali produttori di prodotti medici per l'osteosisi nella zona del cranio e delle estremità del viso. A beneficio del paziente, Medartis si impegna a fornire chirurghi e personale chirurgico con i più innovativi impianti e strumenti di titanio e fornire il miglior servizio.

To strengthen our Marketing & Medical Education team in Basel, we are looking for a committed personality as an Associate Documentation Manager.
In this role, you make a significant contribution to ensuring that our product and marketing documentation meets the highest quality and compliance requirements. They accompany documents throughout their entire life cycle, ensure their timeliness and availability and work closely with marketing, medical affairs, regulatory affairs and other interdisciplinary teams. In addition, you support the continuous digitalization and optimization of our documentation processes.
Do you want to make an important contribution to the success of innovative medical technology with your structured working method and your quality awareness? We look forward to your application.

Associate Documentation Manager

Your responsibilities

• They support the management of global product and marketing documentation throughout the document lifecycle.

• They maintain document management systems, databases and document repositories and ensure the completeness, traceability and timeliness of the documentation.

• They review and revise documents in terms of comprehensibility, consistency, language, layout, and compliance with regulatory requirements and corporate design guidelines.

• They work closely with marketing, medical affairs, regulatory affairs and other internal stakeholders to ensure high-quality and timely documentation.

• They support the creation and maintenance of order information, product catalogues and the communication of documentation-relevant changes.

• They coordinate the management of printed documentation, including print orders and stocks.

• You actively participate in the digitization and continuous optimization of documentation processes, systems and workflows.

• They make an important contribution to compliance with internal quality standards and regulatory requirements and ensure efficient documentation management.

Your qualifications

• Completed technical or commercial training with further training in marketing, communication, technical documentation or a comparable specialisation.

• Two to five years of professional experience in medical technology, pharmaceutical industry or a comparable regulated environment.

• Experience in technical documentation, document management or regulatory documentation processes.

• Strong quality awareness and a structured, precise and reliable way of working.

• Experience working with document management systems as well as very good knowledge of Microsoft Office 365; Knowledge of Adobe Acrobat/InDesign as well as TYPO3 or PLM systems is an advantage.

• Analytical thinking skills and an independent, solution-oriented and well-organized way of working.

• Team-oriented personality with strong communication skills and enjoy working together in an international environment.

• Very good knowledge of German and English in words and writing; Further language skills are advantageous.

About Medartis

Medartis is one of the leading manufacturers of medical products for osteosynthesis in the area of the facial skull and extremities. For the benefit of the patient, Medartis is committed to providing surgeons and surgical staff with the most innovative titanium implants and instruments and providing the best service.

We offer you a responsible and varied activity with high quality requirements in a growing, international company with progressive social benefits.

We look forward to your complete online application.

jobs.description:
The position serves as the process owner for Nonconformance and CAPA Management and works cross-functionally with Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, to drive compliance, product quality, patient safety, and continuous improvement.

To strengthen our Quality team at our headquarters in Basel, we are looking for an experienced and analytical professional as

CAPA and NC Manager

Your responsibilities

• Own and maintain the NC-CAPA process and associated procedures

• Ensure compliance with requirements for control of nonconforming products

• Lead and facilitate investigations, root cause analysis, and definition of the associated corrective and preventive actions

• Train and coach a network of NC-CAPA Owners throughout the organization

• Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex quality issues

• Ensure investigations are evidence-based, timely, and adequately documented

• Drive sustainable corrective actions that address true root causes

• Verify effectiveness of implemented actions prior to CAPA closure

• Present the NC-CAPA process and records during external audits

• Ensure CAPAs are completed within established timelines and meet regulatory and internal requirements

• Prepare quality metrics and reports for management review

• Analyze quality events and CAPA Metrics to define the appropriate strategies to eliminate Field Safety Corrective Actions

• Promote a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement

Your qualifications

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline

• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Systems within the medical device industry

• Minimum 3 years of experience managing CAPA and/or Nonconformance processes

• Experience supporting regulatory inspections and external audits preferred

• Strong knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 requirements

• Understanding of CAPA, Nonconformance Management, Complaint Handling, Supplier Quality, and Risk Management processes

• Experience with root cause analysis and problem-solving methodologies

• Proficiency in electronic quality management systems (eQMS) and quality metrics analysis

• Fluent in German and English, written and spoken

• Results-oriented with strong cross-functional collaboration skills

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a regulated environment

About Medartis

Medartis is one of the leading manufacturers of medical devices for osteosynthesis in the field of craniomaxillofacial surgery as well as the extremities.Medartis is committed to  providing surgeons and operating room personnel with innovative titanium implants, instruments and services that represent advances in bone fixation and thus patients‘ quality of life.

We offer you a diverse and interesting role with high quality requirements within a growing international company with excellent social benefits.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application.

For further information please visit our website www.medartis.com

HR Process Excellence & Systems Specialist 100%

Your responsibilities

HR Process Management

• Map current HR workflows, identify operational bottlenecks, and design streamlined, automated solutions aligned with the existing HR systems.

• Ensure HR process design and documentation are compliant with regulatory and internal requirements.

• Define, document, and continuously improve HR processes – ensure processes are aligned with best practice.

• Lead the planning, coordination and execution of annual core HR processes (e.g., Performance Management, Compensation Planning, External Reporting).

HR Systems

• Responsibility for the administration, support, and continuous development of the global HR systems landscape, especially SAP SuccessFactors.

• Analyse, coordinate and implement system changes and improvements with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders.

• Consulting and support for internal stakeholders regarding SAP SuccessFactors-related topics and processes.

• Administration and development of the Learning platform within SAP SuccessFactors, ensuring effective user support and content management.

• Ensure the availability of training materials and conduct or coordinate user trainings.

• Ensure system documentation, compliance, and adherence to global data privacy standards.

• Ensure a high‑quality HR data foundation that enables efficient reporting and meaningful people analytics while complying with data privacy and security requirements.

• Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and standardized reporting to support data-driven decision making.

• Create, analyze, and provide HR reports and KPIs to global stakeholders.

• Define and continuously improve standards for HR master data quality and data management.

• Ensure compliance with data policies and execute required controls in line with regulatory and internal requirements.

• 3–5 years HRIS experience with hands‑on administration of SAP SuccessFactors and strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 and advanced Excel.

• Solid understanding of HR data governance and privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR).
